adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `hubspotRefreshToken` is assigned from `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and typed as `HubspotToken`. But `refreshOAuthTokens` (new in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`) returns a raw `fetch(...)` `Response` object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is truthy. HubSpot’s code does not parse the `Response` (unlike other call sites that call `handleErrorsJson` / parse JSON), so in sync mode it will treat a `Response` as a `HubspotToken`, which will break downstream expiry/token calculations and credential updates.
